title.value: Build a home cleaning service app and marketing assets

introduction.value: A team used Manus to create a working home cleaning service mobile app with listings, scheduling and contact features in under 10 minutes. It also produced a marketing visual set and a website for an AI education platform.

method.value: Using Manus AI 1.6 Max, the team gave one prompt asking for a fully working mobile app for a local home cleaning business. Manus made a development checklist, designed the screens, built booking, and generated a logo. Separately, one prompt each produced marketing visuals (Instagram posts, hero banner, email header) for Skilap AI, plus a multi-page marketing website for an AI education platform.

outcome.value: The cleaning app, with service listings, scheduling and contact features, was working in under 10 minutes. The visual set had 10+ Instagram designs, and the website had home, courses, pricing and contact pages. The source gives no quality problems or edits.

notes.value: The app can be shared as a preview link for testing before any app store publishing; the source recommends human review of outputs generally.

source_text.body:
Build a home cleaning service app and marketing assets
A team used Manus to create a working home cleaning service mobile app with listings, scheduling and contact features in under 10 minutes. It also produced a marketing visual set and a website for an AI education platform.
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
Using Manus AI 1.6 Max, the team gave one prompt asking for a fully working mobile app for a local home cleaning business. Manus made a development checklist, designed the screens, built booking, and generated a logo. Separately, one prompt each produced marketing visuals (Instagram posts, hero banner, email header) for Skilap AI, plus a multi-page marketing website for an AI education platform.
How it went
The cleaning app, with service listings, scheduling and contact features, was working in under 10 minutes. The visual set had 10+ Instagram designs, and the website had home, courses, pricing and contact pages. The source gives no quality problems or edits.
Worth knowing
The app can be shared as a preview link for testing before any app store publishing; the source recommends human review of outputs generally.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Build a working mobile-friendly app for [type of business, e.g. a home cleaning service] with service listings, a booking and scheduling form, and contact details. Use placeholder content for [business name] and keep the design clean and simple. When it is running, give me the preview link and a list of what to change before I launch it for real.
Original source: https://growwstacks.com/blog/manus-ai-use-cases
